method.title: Methodology and interpretation limits
method.subtitle: A frozen, vehicle-local analysis of one returned history window.
method.sequence: Records are stably sorted by start time inside source-order segments; an unparseable start creates a local boundary.
method.continuity: A linked pair needs adjacent included records, non-overlapping timestamps, matching normalized addresses or GPS within {{meters}} m, and a gap at or below {{minutes}} minutes.
method.invariant: Each included drive belongs to one observed journey, so journey count equals included drives minus linked pairs.
method.energy: Energy intensity uses complete-energy journeys only and is reported in canonical Wh/m before display-unit formatting; coverage and support remain visible.
method.clock: The analysis clock is fixed at page load and calendar profiles use the vehicle IANA timezone: {{timeZone}}.
method.scope: Returned history is capped at {{limit}} rows and is not a claim about lifetime history. Structural indicators and observed energy-intensity differences do not establish intent or causality.
